caption: The bill-payment form loses three of its four boxes and two of its three remembered items: the consumer number fetches the bill, the amount becomes read-only text, and the bill ID is dropped because it arrives with the fetched bill.

spec.title: Bill payment screen: before and after
spec.aria: The bill-payment form starts with 4 input boxes and 3 items the user must recall, then three redesign moves turn it into 1 box and 1 recalled item.
